requests.question: Phase H's read gate cannot be flipped today: attaching `require_session` to the read surface would break the Streamlit dashboard, which is still a live consumer. How should it be sequenced?

options.label: Retire both consumers first, then flip the gate
options.implication: Open the dashboard PR, delete the Streamlit Community Cloud app, and establish Android makes no reads; then flip API_READ_GATE_MODE=enforce. Slowest, and the only order in which nothing the operator uses breaks.

options.label: Flip the gate now and accept that Streamlit breaks
options.implication: Closes the unauthenticated read surface immediately. The Streamlit dashboard starts 401-ing; the SPA needs its login built first or BOTH frontends go dark.

options.label: Gate only the routes no remaining consumer calls
options.implication: Narrower blast radius, but it leaves a mixed surface where "gated" is per-route and a new route defaults OPEN — the same inversion failure the DB-explorer allowlist was just built to end.

options.label: Leave the read surface ungated, as a declared decision
options.implication: The full trading history stays world-readable. Legitimate only if it is DECIDED and recorded, rather than drifted into — which is the state it is in today.

requests.context: The design says archiving the other two consumers is "what makes that tractable — there is nothing else left to keep working". MEASURED against that: Streamlit's retirement sits on an UNOPENED `ict-trader-dashboard` branch (`claude/phase-h-preconditions-retire-streamlit`, no PR — that repo has no `pr-opener.yml` relay), and the Android app was deliberately not touched because it is ON ICE. So the precondition `BL-20260901-RETIRE-ANDROID-AND-STREAMLIT-FROM-THE-LIVE-FEED` is NOT met, whatever a summary may say. ⚠️ Separately: the DB-explorer precondition (#10682) is MERGED but its own done_condition needs the narrowed route DEPLOYED and re-probed — a merge is not a deploy. ⚠️ And state the exposure plainly: `GET /api/bot/db/tables` answers 200 unauthenticated on a public host, and the tables behind it are not empty — `signals` 2,301,022 rows, `trades` 5,313, `order_packages` 4,272 (measured by `session_01LvzsinECH8HPCyauVJZBZw`, 2026-09-01).
requests.objectTitle: Phase H — the control half — decisions from the UI, and the read gate

writeGate.note: DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN is UNSET, so POST /api/bot/work/decision refuses with 503. This is FAIL-CLOSED and deliberate (the prop.py polarity), not an outage: a dropped .env value closes writes rather than reopening an anonymous write hole.

note: The repo is the source of truth. This route reports `committed` ONLY from an `answer` block on the work object in the repo — never from the transit log — so an answer that does not commit leaves its question UNANSWERED. Transit fails BACK, never forward.
